name: code-format
author: lumine-code
description: Format code on demand or on save using registered providers.

formatOnSave.title: Format On Save
formatOnSave.description: Format the buffer with the registered on-save providers whenever it is saved. Read per language, so it can be enabled for selected grammars only via scoped settings.

formatOnType.title: Format On Type
formatOnType.description: Format around the cursor as you type. Read per language, so it can be enabled for selected grammars only via scoped settings.

defaultProvider.title: Default Formatter
defaultProvider.description: Package name of the formatter to use. Leave empty to select the first capable provider by priority. Can be overridden per language.

includedGlobs.title: Included Save Globs
includedGlobs.description: When non-empty, format only matching project-relative paths on save. Overrides excluded globs.

excludedGlobs.title: Excluded Save Globs
excludedGlobs.description: Project-relative paths to skip when formatting on save. A pattern without a slash matches the basename.

showInStatusBar.title: Show Save Status
showInStatusBar.description: Show format-on-save state for the current file in the status bar. Alt-click to observe the file.
